The Future of jobs is in focus as software is getting smarter and new kinds of A.I. are appearing. 

Michael SpencerFeb 20, 2023∙ Paid112ShareMirageC/Getty Images

Hey Everyone, 

Many of our are beginning to question whether ChatGPT will make our job obsolete. I think it’s a valid concern. 

Are our own skills replaceable by an A.I., robots or smarter software? 

That is, will ChatGPT and Generative A.I. innovations impact our jobs or even displace some of our skills or disrupt our positions? The reality is in the decades to come; software, robotics and A.I. will only get smarter. 

We used to think of automation as something that displaced lower tiers of manual labor, the grind of repetitive work better left to machines. 

But what happens when it comes for knowledge workers across industries in a wave of technological automation that we’ve never seen before for services jobs, clerical positions and even white collar workers - people like accountants, teachers and lawyers?
